title: Tokenization and Representation Biases in Multilingual Models on Dialectal NLP Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Tokenization Parity (ratio of tokenized lengths) and Information Parity (ratio of negative log-likelihoods) relative to English, and correlating these representational bias metrics with downstream model performance on Dialect Identification, Topic Classification, and Extractive Question Answering tasks across various languages and dialects.

Comparing Tokenization Parity, Information Parity, and the percentage of missing characters in model vocabularies between Latin and non-Latin scripts to evaluate tokenization fragmentation and representation disparities.
